author: jyeom-intel
title: Windows GPU unit tests job fails extracting OpenVINO packages due to locked tbb12.dll
signature: windows runner extract openvino packages expand-archive remove-item access to the path denied unauthorizedaccessexception locked dll file|Infrastructure

failed_jobs.name: GPU unit tests
failed_jobs.symptom: Extract OpenVINO packages step fails: Expand-Archive cannot overwrite tbb12.dll (Access to the path is denied)

key_errors:
Remove-Item : Cannot remove item C:\actions-runner\_work\openvino\openvino\install\runtime\3rdparty\tbb\bin\tbb12.dll:
Access to the path 'C:\actions-runner\_work\openvino\openvino\install\runtime\3rdparty\tbb\bin\tbb12.dll' is denied.
At C:\Windows\system32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\Modules\Microsoft.PowerShell.Archive\Microsoft.PowerShell.Archive.psm1:1029
+ FullyQualifiedErrorId : RemoveFileSystemItemUnAuthorizedAccess,Microsoft.PowerShell.Commands.RemoveItemCommand
##[error]Process completed with exit code 1.
root_cause: The 'Extract OpenVINO packages' step runs Expand-Archive -Force on a pre-existing install directory from a prior job on the same self-hosted Windows runner. tbb12.dll under install/runtime/3rdparty/tbb/bin is still memory-mapped/locked by a lingering process (e.g. an orphaned test executable or antivirus scan) from the previous job, so PowerShell's archive module cannot delete it before re-extracting, causing a hard failure instead of a retry. This is the same recurring runner-state issue seen in prior post-commit runs (pattern 514ffa2ab52ad344, now at 13 occurrences since 2026-11-09), unrelated to the PR's content (GPU group_normalization_ref kernel rewrite, PR #39562).
reproduction_steps: N/A - requires the specific Windows self-hosted runner state (locked DLL handle from a previous job) to reproduce; not reproducible via a clean local Windows PowerShell run of Expand-Archive alone.
recommended_actions: Add a pre-extraction cleanup/retry step that terminates lingering processes (e.g. taskkill on known test binaries) holding handles on install/ before Expand-Archive runs.

Replace 'Expand-Archive -Force' with a script that retries removal of locked files a few times with backoff, or deletes the install directory recursively before extracting instead of relying on -Force overwrite semantics.
Investigate why tbb12.dll remains locked after the previous job on this runner completes - check for runner reuse/cleanup gaps, e.g. a GPU unit test process or antivirus holding the handle open.
Consider using a fresh/ephemeral runner workspace per job, or an explicit workspace-clean step, for the Windows GPU unit tests job.
prevention_strategies: Make the Windows package-extraction step resilient to locked files left over from previous jobs on reused self-hosted runners: clean the install directory with a retry/backoff wrapper (or process-kill of any orphaned executables under install/) before Expand-Archive -Force, and ensure test processes fully exit before the job completes.
historical_context: Pattern 514ffa2ab52ad344 'Windows GPU unit tests job fails extracting OpenVINO packages due to locked tbb12.dll' has recurred 13 times since first observed 2026-11-09T16:30:00Z, most recently just before this run (2026-11-18T06:39:47Z, run 44218718166) and now again in this run. It is consistently an Infrastructure/runner-state issue, never traced to a specific PR's code changes.
